svg.title: How Sales Mama works
svg.desc: Overnight, scouts find signals, resolve.py links them to accounts, score.py tiers them, VAMs set next steps and allocate.py proposes a split. At 08:30 the manager approves. At 08:45 each rep runs /mama-day: research, recommend, draft, saved in their own mailbox. In the send window a person presses send; replies, handover and the weekly review feed back into tomorrow's scores.
svg.text: One loop a day. Agents prepare, people decide.
Nothing is assigned until the manager approves.
Unsure company matches wait in the review queue.
Web text is data, not orders
Agents: Scout · Researcher · VAM · Writer · Allocator — maths in scripts, judgement in the LLM, decisions with people. Times shown for Singapore.
